message_text: I'm an international student from India. What documents do I need for the F-1 visa?
You'll need: your I-20 form (issued after admission), valid passport, DS-160 confirmation, financial documentation showing ability to cover costs, and SEVIS fee receipt.
When will I receive the I-20?
The I-20 is typically mailed within 2-3 weeks after you submit your enrollment deposit and financial documentation.
Can you also help with housing for international students?
Yes! We have an International Student Housing program with early move-in dates and orientation. The International Student Services office also helps with airport pickup.
That's wonderful. You've been very helpful with all the visa info. Thank you!
My pleasure! Welcome to our university community. Feel free to reach out anytime.
